g.text: One project. One execution owner. CLI for agents, dashboard for people.
EXECUTION HOST · detected machine / VPS · one installation per project
Jobs receive inference access; no Docker socket, host admin, SSH, GitHub or deploy credentials.
GitHub import uses host gh access. Publication stays with the operator; it is not a job permission.
Failed checks stop delivery. Requested revisions repeat Implement → Check → Review; old attempts remain.
Authorized PR → protected CI → merge/release is a separate delivery action. Acceptance never publishes automatically.
DEFENCE Scoped incident evidence → Investigate agent → private draft for validation
No live monitoring or production recovery in the current runtime.
Automations + GitHub identity · per-role profiles · scorers/benchmarks · scoped MCP · optional Coolify hosting
